prompts.title: Racha reciente: kinetic type then grouped count bars
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, 1080×1920. Keep the lower quarter clear at all times for permanent yellow burned-in subtitles; every element lives above that band on GoatLab charcoal #101412.

EDITORIAL VARIANT (primary, first half of the clip): kinetic typography with rhythmic emphasis. The Spanish headline «RACHA» builds letter by letter with an 80 ms stagger in warm white #edf0e6, then three Spanish slabs snap in on the beat — «VICTORIAS» on lime #c5ed74, «EMPATES» on slate #8ca6bf, «DERROTAS» back on lime — each slab punching in with a 2-frame overshoot and settling. Below them the Spanish team names «Crystal Palace» and «Newcastle United» rise as small caps with wide tracking. On the third beat all three slabs compress toward centre and «DERROTAS» flashes slate for two frames as the single focal point. No axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Camera: locked, with only a 3-frame vertical drift. Transition: a lime wipe sweeps bottom-to-top, dissolving the type into the statistical card. Exit: typography collapses upward behind the subtitle band.

STATISTICAL VARIANT (second half): grouped count bars, horizontal, three categories (victorias, empates, derrotas) along a shared zero baseline with one common scale in partidos. Each category group holds two bars — Crystal Palace in lime, Newcastle United in slate — with values {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}, all in partidos. Spanish category labels sit under each group; the unit «partidos» closes the axis. A sample strip beneath the chart reads «muestra» with {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} partidos and the source credit «Bzzoiro / últimos partidos», so any unequal sample is visible at a glance. Bars grow from the zero baseline in staggered 350 ms increments; on the main comparison the derrotas pair holds while a thin warm-white bracket links the two. Emphasis: the longer bar keeps a soft lime rim, the shorter desaturates toward slate. Camera: slow push-in on the derrotas group, roughly a tenth of the frame. Transition: all bars compress into a single hairline and slide off left. Exit: card fades to charcoal, subtitle band intact.

prompts.title: Goles a favor y en contra: pitch path then paired bars
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, 1080×1920, charcoal #101412 ground; the lower quarter stays reserved for permanent yellow subtitles and nothing crosses it.

EDITORIAL VARIANT (primary, opening half): an illustrative football pitch drawn as thin warm white #edf0e6 lines in perspective, tilted slightly, occupying the upper half. A lime #c5ed74 ball traces a curved attacking path toward the top goal, leaves a fading trail, and rebounds once as the pitch tilts — a purely graphic motion beat, no invented match events, no scoreline claims, no axes. Spanish headline «GOLES» assembles from two halves that click together like a hinge; beneath it the Spanish labels «a favor» and «en contra» slide in from opposite edges on slate #8ca6bf cards. Emphasis lands on the goal mouth, where the line weight doubles for four frames. Camera: gentle 5-frame upward drift with the ball's arc. Transition: the pitch lines fold inward into two vertical rails that become the chart frame. Exit: the ball exits top of frame, trail dissolving.

STATISTICAL VARIANT (closing half): paired bars, four bars in two pairs. Crystal Palace pair — «a favor» {{home.gf}} and «en contra» {{home.ga}} — sits left; Newcastle United pair — «a favor» {{away.gf}} and «en contra» {{away.ga}} — sits right. One shared scale in goles, zero baseline common to all four, faint gridlines at equal steps, Spanish labels on every bar with the unit «goles» at the axis head. A football-context caption above the chart reads «últimos partidos» in Spanish, and a sample strip below reads «muestra» with {{home.n}} and {{away.n}} partidos plus the source credit «Bzzoiro», printed small on slate. Entry: bars rise in pairs, 320 ms each, the away pair 120 ms behind. Main comparison: the warm-white bracket spans each pair so the for/against tension reads instantly. Emphasis: the taller bar of each pair brightens to lime, the shorter settles to slate. Camera: locked with a fine lateral drift. Transition: bars shrink to their value labels, which fade. Exit: charcoal field holds under the subtitle band.

prompts.title: Cruces históricos: visual duel then win/draw counts
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, 1080×1920, charcoal #101412 ground; the lower quarter stays clear for permanent yellow subtitles.

EDITORIAL VARIANT (primary, first half): a visual duel. Two vertical slabs face each other across a thin warm white #edf0e6 seam — Crystal Palace slab in lime #c5ed74, Newcastle United slab in slate #8ca6bf — each with the Spanish team name set in condensed caps vertically along its inner edge. On the beat the slabs lean inward and clash, sending a single warm-white shock line down the seam; a small Spanish tag «cara a cara» snaps above it. Editorial only: no axes, no counts, no sample claims, no invented match events or forecast language. Emphasis: the seam glow peaks for three frames then drops. Camera: slow lateral parallax, left slab drifting slightly faster than right. Transition: the seam widens into a stacked horizontal bar chart, slabs unspooling into segments. Exit: the shock line retracts to a point and vanishes.

STATISTICAL VARIANT (second half): stacked horizontal bar, one bar, shared scale in partidos. Segments read: Crystal Palace wins {{h2h.homeWins}} in lime, draws {{h2h.draws}} in warm white #edf0e6, Newcastle United wins {{h2h.awayWins}} in slate, with Spanish segment labels and the unit «partidos». The bar total and the sample annotation read «cruces previos» {{h2h.total}} partidos, with the source credit «Bzzoiro / historial» set small beneath. A Spanish disclaimer line reads «historial, no pronóstico» so the sequence is never read as a forecast. Entry: the bar draws left to right in 600 ms with segments snapping into place sequentially; labels fade up 150 ms later. Main comparison: the away segment pulses once, then all three settle. Emphasis: labels keep high contrast, the largest segment holds a subtle lime-lift without claiming prediction. Camera: locked with a slight 2-frame push. Transition: the stack compresses to a single line and fades. Exit: charcoal hold beneath the subtitle band.
